# Define possible root cause components
root_cause_components = [
    'apache01', 'apache02', 'Tomcat01', 'Tomcat02', 'Tomcat03', 'Tomcat04',
    'MG01', 'MG02', 'IG01', 'IG02', 'Mysql01', 'Mysql02', 'Redis01', 'Redis02'
]

if not log_df.empty:
    # Convert timestamp to datetime with UTC+8 timezone
    log_df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(log_df['timestamp'], unit='s').dt.tz_localize('UTC').dt.tz_convert('Asia/Shanghai')

    # Define the time window for filtering: 14:30 to 15:00 on March 6, 2021 (UTC+8)
    start_time = pd.Timestamp('2021-03-06 14:30:00', tz='Asia/Shanghai')
    end_time = pd.Timestamp('2021-03-06 15:00:00', tz='Asia/Shanghai')

    # Filter logs by component and time window
    filtered_log_df = log_df[
        (log_df['cmdb_id'].isin(root_cause_components)) &
        (log_df['datetime'] >= start_time) &
        (log_df['datetime'] <= end_time)
    ]

    # Count logs per component
    log_counts = filtered_log_df.groupby('cmdb_id').size().reset_index(name='log_count')

    # Filter logs that indicate errors, warnings, or unusual events by searching keywords in log_name or value (case insensitive)
    keywords = ['error', 'warn', 'fail', 'exception', 'critical', 'fatal', 'timeout', 'oom', 'out of memory']
    pattern = '|'.join(keywords)
    error_logs = filtered_log_df[
        filtered_log_df['log_name'].str.contains(pattern, case=False, na=False) |
        filtered_log_df['value'].str.contains(pattern, case=False, na=False)
    ][['cmdb_id', 'log_name', 'value', 'datetime']]

else:
    filtered_log_df = pd.DataFrame()
    log_counts = pd.DataFrame()
    error_logs = pd.DataFrame()
